part.text:
I followed the corridor to the red wall and stopped in front of it, about 0.7 m away according to the side sensors. The robot is now resting (motors off, crouched).

The route had several turns and a couple of dead ends. Along the way I had to back out of one dead-end pocket and try another opening before I could see the red wall and head toward it.
